sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(T2.name) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.name) FROM enlist AS T1 LEFT JOIN male AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name WHERE T1.organ = 'fire_department'
SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.name) FROM person AS T1 LEFT JOIN male AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name
SELECT CAST((SUM(IIF(month = 0, 1, 0)) - SUM(IIF(month = 9, 1, 0))) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(IIF(month = 0, 1, 0)) FROM longest_absense_from_school

SELECT T1.name FROM male AS T1 INNER JOIN unemployed AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name INNER JOIN disabled AS T3 ON T1.name = T3.name INNER JOIN longest_absense_from_school AS T4 ON T1.name = T4.name WHERE T4.month = 5
SELECT COUNT(T2.name) - SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NULL, 1, 0)) FROM filed_for_bankrupcy AS T1 LEFT JOIN male AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name
